svg.title: 30 Self-Improving Agent — Research Loop + Prompt Evolution
svg.desc: One process (demo.js main) that researches a question through an observable harness, grades its own answer, runs a postmortem on the trace, and lets an LLM rewrite its own system prompt for the next round — closing a measurable self-improvement loop. Real fetch() to LLM providers and Wikipedia; cross-session memory in SQLite. Every element cites a source line in FACTS.md.

g.text: ① Self-improvement loop — demo.js main() (Node ESM · better-sqlite3)
② External network — real fetch(), no mock
thrown step logged & skipped, not fatal
→ LLM writes ONE patch → prompt v{N+1}
